method_limits: FEDS-CONUS exposes its own fireID, not the FPA-FOD identifier. The event match is provisional and uses only FPA-FOD discovery date, reported point, FEDS t_st, and the fixed spatial tolerance.
The FPA-FOD point has unreported event-specific uncertainty and its date has no timezone in this adapter; the date window is intentionally recorded.
The FLE feature service queried here is an incident-level grouped summary. It is not the line-level GIS used for post-hoc spatial comparisons.
No final area, final perimeter, FLE outcome, or test case is used to choose a FEDS fireID.

pre_agent_data_gate.instruction: Stop before agent training if false; a split-only audit is incomplete; do not replace the cohort silently.

derivation.note: A fresh validation-year archive read was attempted but failed because Zenodo DNS could not resolve; the saved earliest-in-radius timestamps were sufficient for this exact post-filter.
derivation.rule: Keep a candidate only when its earliest recorded in-radius perimeter timestamp is between t_st and t_st + 24 hours inclusive. The candidate report records that earliest timestamp and complete temporal run summaries, so this reproduces the strict time predicate without an additional archive read.
